title: Balancing the Picture: Debiasing Vision-Language Datasets with Synthetic Contrast Sets

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating vision-language models for caption-to-image retrieval bias using Bias@K and MaxSkew@K metrics with gender-neutral queries. The evaluation compares model behavior on a naturally unbalanced dataset (COCO) versus a synthetically generated, gender-balanced contrast set (GENSYNTH) where only the subject's gender is edited while the background context remains fixed.
